description: Every hypothesis MML's own economics rest on, moved against it at once: shorter structural life, faster consumption in every life, dearer fleet capital, dearer fuel and cover, more real-use consumption. What the publication must survive.

vehicles.toyota-corolla-ts-hybrid.lifecy.rationale: adverse: structural life at the low end of what a full hybrid estate is expected to reach in Italian use

finance.firstLifeConsumptionFactor.rationale: adverse: a new vehicle consumes mobility value faster than the central hypothesis

finance.laterLifeConsumptionFactor.rationale: adverse: later lives consume the asset no more slowly than the first

finance.fleetCostOfCapital.rationale: adverse: asset-company funding at lessor rather than infrastructure cost

finance.warrantyPoolShare.rationale: adverse: unplanned repair provision half again the central figure

energy.petrolPerLitre.rationale: adverse: petrol 10% above the September 2026 national average

energy.realUseUplift.rationale: adverse: real-use gap at the top of the ICCT range for full hybrids

insurance.comprehensiveShareOfValue.rationale: adverse: comprehensive cover priced for a metropolitan theft area
